title: Plan: Phenomena, Nodes, Orbits, Crossings, Gauquelin
description:
Port remaining swecl.c (~1500 lines) + crossing functions from sweph.c (~1000 lines). Mixed bag of planet-derived computations.

## Phenomena (swecl.c:3791, catalogue-internal §12)
- `swe_pheno(tjd, ipl, iflag, attr, serr)` — phase angle, phase (illuminated fraction), elongation, apparent diameter, magnitude
- Phase angle = arccos(geocentric_unit · heliocentric_unit)
- Phase = (1 + cos(phase_angle)) / 2
- **Magnitude formulas** per body (catalogue-internal §12.2): Sun (-26.86 base), Moon (multi-regime), Mercury/Venus (Mallama 2018 high-order polynomials), Mars (two-regime), Jupiter/Saturn (incl. ring inclination), Uranus/Neptune (quadratic), asteroids (Bowell HG system)

## Nodes & Apsides (swecl.c:5154, catalogue-internal §13)
- `swe_nod_aps(tjd, ipl, iflag, method, xnasc, xndsc, xperi, xaphe, serr)`
- **Mean elements**: polynomial coefficients el_node[], el_peri[], el_incl[], el_ecce[], el_sema[] for each planet
- **Osculating elements** (catalogue-internal §13.2): angular momentum h = r×v, inclination from h, node from orbital/ecliptic plane intersection, eccentricity from vis-viva, true anomaly from eccentric anomaly
- **Lunar osculating elements** (sweph.c:5168): special handling — uses GEOGCONST×(1+1/EARTH_MOON_MRAT), larger dt for Moshier

## Orbital elements (catalogue-internal §17)
- `swe_get_orbital_elements(tjd, ipl, iflag, dret, serr)` — Keplerian elements from state vectors
- `swe_orbit_max_min_true_distance()` — sample both orbits in 2° steps, refine extrema

## Crossings (catalogue-internal §16)
- `swe_solcross(x2cross, jd, flag, serr)` — Newton iteration: dt = (target−current)/speed, initial estimate from mean solar speed 360°/365.24
- `swe_mooncross()` — same with mean lunar speed 360°/27.32
- `swe_mooncross_node()` — detect latitude sign changes, Newton refine: dt = −lat/lat_speed
- `swe_helio_cross()` — heliocentric crossing for any planet

## Gauquelin sectors (catalogue-internal §19)
- `swe_gauquelin_sector(t_ut, ipl, starname, iflag, imeth, geopos, atpress, attemp, dgsect, serr)`
- Geometric method (imeth 0-1): uses swe_house_pos with 'G' system
- Rise/set method (imeth 2-3): interpolate (t-t_rise)/(t_set-t_rise) × 18

## Testing
- setest/suite_07_apsides.c, setest/suite_10_solcross.c
- Phenomena: compute for all planets at known dates, compare magnitudes
- Crossings: equinox dates (Sun crossing 0°/180°), solstice dates

## C source reference
- swecl.c:3791 — swe_pheno
- swecl.c:5154 — swe_nod_aps, mean element arrays, osculating computation
- sweph.c — swe_solcross, swe_mooncross, swe_mooncross_node, swe_helio_cross
- sweph.c:5168 — lunar_osc_elem
- sweph.c:8042 — swe_calc_pctr (planetocentric)

## Dependencies
- Phase 5 (calc pipeline), Phase 10 (houses — for Gauquelin), Phase 11 (rise/set — for Gauquelin imeth 2-3)
execution_record:
Decomposed into 9 implement sub-tasks (swisseph-rs/82–90, "PNOC n/9") with 6 new C ref docs (c-ref-{phenomena,nodaps,orbital-elements,crossings,pctr,gauquelin-riseset}.md, commit a4706a9), each produced by a dedicated sonnet agent per the c_source_budget protocol.

Corrections to the original task description discovered during study:
1. Gauquelin imeth 0/1 (geometric) already landed in swisseph-rs/66 (Ephemeris::gauquelin_sector_geometric) — the Gauquelin sub-task (PNOC 8) covers only imeth 2–5 + the dispatcher. Also: C supports imeth up to 5 (disc-edge variants 4/5), not the 0–3 the task description and the C doc-comment claim.
2. Body::TrueNode/OscuApogee (lunar_osc_elem, sweph.c:5168) are NOT ported — every backend dispatch rejects them. This is a full sub-task (PNOC 3), bigger than the description's one-bullet framing suggested, and also supplies swi_plan_for_osc_elem which the nod_aps osculating branch shares.
3. swe_calc_pctr was listed only under "C source reference" but is covered by no other task — filed as PNOC 9.
4. All dependencies (calc pipeline, houses, rise/set) are done; no sub-task is blocked on other phases.
5. Stale-architecture assumptions handled: all C global-state reads (swed.pldat xsun/xear, oec/nut caches, nddat save slots, save-area restore dances) are mapped to explicit stateless recomputation in the ref docs' Porting Notes tables; caching branches (lunar_osc_elem D.0) are dropped as pure perf optimizations.

Per Josh's directive, PNOC 1 (swisseph-rs/82) is the .sutra/rules.toml constraint activation for the phase's modules; the overdue azalt/riseset constraint blocks (triggers met at RSE 2/3) were uncommented directly during planning (commit 57a25b4) rather than deferred to the sub-task.

Dependency graph kept maximally parallel: only 86→{84,85} (shared helpers) and 87→85 (constants tables) are ordered; 82,83,84,88,89,90 are all immediately ready.

Ref-doc quirk highlights baked into sub-task descriptions: Pluto's stale ipl_to_elem→Mercury-mass mapping and SEFLG_ORBEL_AA≡TOPOCTR aliasing (orbit); lunar node's dead quadratic-speed code superseded by central difference (nodaps D.3); calc_pctr's deflection always Earth-observed while aberration uses the real center; mooncross_node's fixed day-zero latitude reference; two distinct Euler literals in pheno's magnitude formulas.
